description: Schema to extract all available product models from a PDF and capture accurate model-level metadata. Missing values must be coded as NULL. Dimensional data must be separated based on source (table vs diagram).

fields.name: manufacturer_name
fields.instruction: Official manufacturer name extracted from the document. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: model_number
fields.instruction: Extract ALL model numbers explicitly listed in the PDF. Each model must have its own metadata entry. Do not infer or generate models.

fields.name: product_description
fields.instruction: Product description taken from the first page of the PDF. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_line
fields.instruction: Product series or line name explicitly mentioned in the document. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_literature_year
fields.instruction: Year of publication extracted from the document metadata (Created Date). If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: product_literature_id
fields.instruction: Document ID, bulletin number, or literature reference number if explicitly stated. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: shipping_weight
fields.instruction: Shipping or crated weight for the model as listed in tables. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: installed_weight
fields.instruction: Installed, operating, or net weight of the model as listed in tables. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: length
fields.instruction: Overall length extracted from product diagrams only. If diagram data is not available, return NULL.

fields.name: width
fields.instruction: Overall width extracted from product diagrams only. If diagram data is not available, return NULL.

fields.name: height
fields.instruction: Overall height extracted from product diagrams only. If diagram data is not available, return NULL.

fields.name: diameter
fields.instruction: Diameter extracted from product diagrams for cylindrical products. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: length_table
fields.instruction: Length value extracted from specification tables. Use this field only if table data is present. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: width_table
fields.instruction: Width value extracted from specification tables. Use this field only if table data is present. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: height_table
fields.instruction: Height value extracted from specification tables. Use this field only if table data is present. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: diameter_table
fields.instruction: Diameter value extracted from specification tables. Use this field only if table data is present. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: minimum_circuit_amps_mca
fields.instruction: Minimum circuit amperes for the model as listed in electrical specification tables. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: maximum_overcurrent_protection_mop
fields.instruction: Maximum over-current protection value (MOP or MOCP) for the model. If not available, return NULL.

fields.name: power_supply_configuration
fields.instruction: Electrical power supply configuration for the model (Volts/Hertz/Phase). If not available, return NULL.
